I know that fertilizer can help my rice yield, and I try to buy some subsidized NPK from the agro-dealer in town when it is available, though the supply is often unreliable. I usually save seed from my last harvest because improved seed is expensive and the dealer does not always have rice seed in stock. My wife and children will do most of the weeding and processing, but during transplanting and harvesting I will need to hire some day laborers from the village since everyone is busy at the same time.
